description_en: You can invoke AddPhoneNumbers to add one or more phone numbers to a specified instance
description_zh: 调用AddPhoneNumbers添加一个或多个号码到指定实例下
kebab_example: aliyun ccc add-phone-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --contact-flow-id dDMD_0mif4hv --usage Bidirection --number-list 01012340000_,_01056780000 --number-group-id 2cb77c29-5f60-4b90-b21e-9d2ba9833f14 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddPhoneNumbers

parameters.description_en: ID of the IVR contact flow to attach. This parameter is valid only when the number usage includes inbound calls. It is optional and defaults to empty.
parameters.description_zh: 绑定的IVR联系流ID，仅当号码用途包含呼入时，该参数才有效，非必填，默认为空。
parameters.help_en: ID of the IVR contact flow to attach. This parameter is valid only when the number usage includes inbound calls. It is optional and defaults to empty
parameters.help_zh: 绑定的IVR联系流ID，仅当号码用途包含呼入时，该参数才有效，非必填，默认为空
parameters.name: contact_flow_id

parameters.description_en: Usage of the phone number. Note: If the provided number is a 400 number, the usage must be set to Inbound.
parameters.description_zh: 号码的用途，注意，如果传入的号码为400号码，则用途只能填Inbound。
parameters.help_en: Usage of the phone number. Note: If the provided number is a 400 number, the usage must be set to Inbound
parameters.help_zh: 号码的用途，注意，如果传入的号码为400号码，则用途只能填Inbound
parameters.name: usage

parameters.description_en: List of phone numbers to add.
parameters.help_en: List of phone numbers to add
parameters.name: number_list

parameters.description_en: Number group ID. You can view number grouping information in the Cloud Contact Center console. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty.
parameters.description_zh: 号码组ID，在云联络中心控制台可以看到号码分组信息，非必填，默认为空。
